content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Part-Time Doctor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR CFTRI Part-Time Doctor (Allopathic System) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Part-time Doctor (Allopathic System) position at CSIR CFTRI is scheduled for 22nd September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Part-time Doctor (Allopathic System) post is an MBBS degree from a recognized University or Institute. No other qualifications are specified.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Part-time Doctor position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Part-time Doctor (Allopathic System) post is 64 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the announcement.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Part-time Doctor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Part-time Doctor (Allopathic System) position at CSIR CFTRI. This is a single opening announced through the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Part-time Doctor (Allopathic System) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 46,020/- per month. This is a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Part-time Doctor (Allopathic System) position at CSIR CFTRI. All candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to directly attend the interview at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Central Food Technological Research Institute (CSIR CFTRI), Mysuru, Karnataka, 570020. Candidates should report to the designated venue on the interview date.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents, along with one set of self-attested photocopies and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Part-time Doctor (Allopathic System) position is Part Time. This indicates that the role is not a full-time commitment.
